What is wrong: 609 of 609 data components store no fetchMode; all carry readyToLoad: true and resolve to the default re-query path.
Recommended fix: Decide a pattern-wide default and set Data Fetch Mode explicitly on data components rather than relying on the implicit one. Full per-component inventory in county-template-qa-fetchmode.csv.

Section title: Modeled Risk / Hazard of Concern cards
What is wrong: Clicking hazard to hazard shows the PREVIOUS hazard for ~400ms after the URL changes; 1,800ms click-to-correct. Not reproducible on hard reload. Dev team already aware.
Recommended fix: Suppress the cached paint while a new request is in flight  -  render a loading state instead of the previous fetch's rows.

What is wrong: "...are included in the flooding profile of the MitigateNY SHMP" on every hazard page except flooding (12 of 16).
Recommended fix: Edit the trailing clause in the 12 LHMP_IA narrative rows so each names its own hazard profile. Dataset content, not component config.

What is wrong: 249 unfiltered rows including drought and arson measures on the Extreme Cold page; no stored filter while the page publishes hazards/hazards2/hazards3.
Recommended fix: Columns menu > the hazard column > add a filter bound to the page variable (searchParamKey hazards2), matching how the hazard-scoped siblings are configured.

What is wrong: 196 unfiltered rows, same shape as Measures Inventory.
Recommended fix: Same fix as Measures Inventory: bind the hazard column filter to the page variable.

What is wrong: Renders 3610506310 instead of the municipality name. The live Jurisdictions source defines the lookup; the stored column carries none.
Recommended fix: Columns menu > geoid > Refresh Meta to pick up meta_lookup {view 1346450, geoid -> municipality_name}.

What is wrong: A stored value that is neither a lookup key nor a label falls through and renders raw among 8 correctly-cased labels.
Recommended fix: Fix the data value: change "Ice storm" to the key "icestorm" in the Hazards_of_Concern row(s). The lookup itself is correct.

What is wrong: No integer format on a count column; shows 0.0 beside 13 / 2 / 2 on the home page and on the hazard pages.
Recommended fix: Columns menu > "# of Declared Disasters" > Format: set an integer/comma format so zero renders as 0.

What is wrong: "Category-Deprecated", "Jurisdiction GeoID" and "Hazard Text" are used as public facet labels.
Recommended fix: Rename the source column display_name (the facet label reads from it), or override display_name on the component. Retire the deprecated column once its consumers move.

What is wrong: 10 bucket images 404 and one external hotlink dies; the browser collapses each to a 16px line of alt text, which is the filename.
Recommended fix: Re-upload the missing files or repoint the sections at /themes/mny/illustrations/*.webp. See to-do type 2 for the per-component list.

What is wrong: Zero-row grid with a page counter reading 0 and an enabled NEXT. 11 instances on 5 pages.
Recommended fix: The pager renders unconditionally. Give the component an empty state so a zero-row result says so instead of drawing a pager.

What is wrong: Four tables titled "State Mitigation Capabilities" with 41 / 243 / 11 / 148 rows; the distinguishing information exists only in the filter.
Recommended fix: Retitle each section to name the capability category it is filtered to.

What is wrong: Identical bindings report different totals  -  12 sections on one source/view report 8 different numbers. No pager total on the site is citable.
Recommended fix: display.totalLength is a cached count rendered before the live count arrives. Stop rendering the stored total, or invalidate it on save.

Section title: Extreme Cold / Hazard of Concern / Modeled Risk / Historical Risk
What is wrong: Section padding is the OUTER gutter, so p-4 on each member inserts 32px between boxes; the run is openBottom > borderX x3 with no closer, so there is no bottom edge.
Recommended fix: Set the last member border to openTop, and move the 16px from section padding to the Card's cellsPadding. the_risk/natural_hazards/flooding is already configured correctly  -  copy it.

What is wrong: Content tops differ by 15 / 34 / 84px, produced by hand-tuned 1px / 50px / 100px top paddings.
Recommended fix: Remove the hand-tuned paddings and let the grid align the pair; use equal padding on both members.

What is wrong: (unset) > left > (unset) > center across one four-part card.
Recommended fix: Pick one justify value for all cells in the group. left is the pattern-wide convention at 69% of set values; centre is a legitimate choice but changes the convention.

What is wrong: FUSION YEAR / PRIMARY HAZARD CATEGORY / TOTAL DAMAGE (WITH POPULATION) on hazard pages vs YEAR / NRI CATEGORY / TOTAL DAMAGE here.
Recommended fix: Reconcile the per-component display_name overrides so both copies of the table use one set of headings.

What is wrong: 3 of 5 selects offer no options; on High Hazard Dams a Hazard Level column repeats one value on all 11 rows.
Recommended fix: Populate the facet value lists or remove the empty controls; drop the single-value column.
